uncutNote: Every other face is an identity that has not been cut. The two recorded faces use distinct dapp names; no other identity is claimed.

linkable.note: A shadow account funded the public way: an external account pre-approves it, and the account's first call pulls the funds. The funder's address is in the clear, in the same transaction, and it is a real funded wallet.

apps.name: Vesu
apps.note: Every action takes about six minutes to prove. A deposit does not mind the wait: the amount you asked for is the amount that lands.

apps.name: Endur
apps.note: The same six minutes. A stake is unaffected by the delay, which makes this the second identity in the demo.

apps.name: Ekubo
apps.note: The same six minutes, but a swap price can expire inside them. That is the only reason this one comes last.
apps.verified: class hash confirmed on mainnet, 25 Aug 2026

denominations.why: Identities are funded only in these amounts. An arbitrary figure such as 137.42 STRK identifies you across every identity that uses it; a fixed step does not.

timing.why: Funding and acting are separated by a random delay, so two identities created in one sitting do not appear on chain seconds apart.
